name: Jeroen Lenaers - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council on combating the sexual abuse and sexual exploitation of children and child sexual abuse material and replacing Council Framework Decision 2004/68/JHA (recast)
part_text:
The report sets out Parliament's position on new EU-wide rules against child sexual abuse. It asks for tougher penalties, clearer definitions that cover images made or altered with artificial intelligence, and duties to report abuse. It wants victims to get free support, legal help and compensation, and it wants time limits for prosecuting these crimes and claiming compensation removed. It also asks for better training for people who work with children.

- New offences and higher maximum prison terms for abuse, exploitation and abuse material, including AI-generated images.
- Affects offenders, victims, employers, online platforms, hotlines and professionals working with children.
- Next, Parliament negotiates the final text with EU governments; it is not law yet.
